original_issue_and_resolution.original_observed_issue: Principal formulas were unqualified although valid only inside D<P<U; outside they could yield a negative token amount.85%illustrativecases remained correct.
original_issue_and_resolution.resolution: Root explicitly qualified in-range scope and supplied clamped sqrt price for outside ranges. The current document now describes nonnegative one-sided amounts.
original_issue_and_resolution.verified_current_excerpt:
For one continuous Uniswap range with ZZZ price P in ETH, liquidity L and bounds
D/U, while D<P<U the principal is:

- ZZZ=L*(1/sqrt(P)-1/sqrt(U));
- ETH=L*(sqrt(P)-sqrt(D));
- NAV=ZZZ*P+ETH.

Outside the range, clamp sqrt(P) to the sqrt(D)/sqrt(U) endpoints in the token
amount formulas. The resulting principal is one-sided, never a negative amount.
